extract_enclosing_subgraphs: extract k-hop enclosing subgraphs from a graph adjacency matrix for a set of links
construct_pyg_graph: construct a PyTorch Geometric Data object from a sparse adjacency matrix and node features
do_edge_split: split a graph dataset into train, validation, and test edge splits with optional negative sampling
compute_cn_scores: compute Common Neighbor heuristic link prediction scores for all edges in an edge index
track_experiment_results: track and print statistics for multiple runs of graph link prediction experiments
